summary: Li Bang International Corp Inc. files Form 6-K furnishing unaudited interim consolidated financial statements and management discussion for the six months ended December 31, 2025. This is a routine periodic reporting obligation for a foreign private issuer, incorporated by reference into an existing F-3 registration statement. No transaction, strategic change, or special situation is disclosed. The filing contains standard cautionary language and exhibits covering financial performance only. As a routine earnings update under Rule 13a-16, it does not constitute an event-driven special situation.
